dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder (non-organic/conversion disorder) presenting as abnormal gaze position, given entirely normal ocular motor examination, normal pupils, normal visual function, and normal brain imaging with recent onset.

1. Focal (non-motor) seizure with brief impaired awareness – MRI and clinical course would need EEG to exclude
2. Simple motor tic or habit disorder – episodic and suppressible gaze deviation
3. Voluntary/factitious abnormal eye posture during the video – cannot be excluded without prolonged observation and confrontational testing
